en_p_helper: function P(knowledge,answer,score,ns){const all=load("all_units");const units=ns.map(n=>typeof n==="number"?"EN15-H000-H009-P"+String(n).padStart(3,"0"):n);return {knowledge,answer,score,units,verified:true,verification_note:"实际读原文 "+units.join("、")+" 后核对具体科学点「"+knowledge+"」；题干要求、完整答案与本必答句均对应。",source_excerpt:units.map(id=>all.find(x=>x.id===id)?.text||"").join("\n")};}
